name: contentful-akamai-lambda
description: AWS Lambda: sync Contentful content to Akamai NetStorage

scripts.build:webhook:
printf '%s
' 'import { handler } from "./src/contentful-webhook-receiver.js";' 'export { handler };' > index.js && rm -f ./dist/webhook-receiver.zip && zip -r ./dist/webhook-receiver.zip index.js src/contentful-webhook-receiver.js package.json package-lock.json node_modules
scripts.build:fetcher:
printf '%s
' 'import { handler } from "./src/contentful-entry-fetcher.js";' 'export { handler };' > index.js && rm -f ./dist/entry-fetcher.zip && zip -r ./dist/entry-fetcher.zip index.js src/contentful-entry-fetcher.js package.json package-lock.json node_modules
scripts.build: npm run build:webhook && npm run build:fetcher
scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:webhook && npm run deploy:fetcher
